cues.en: I'm doctor Emmett Brown. I'm standing on a parking lot at Twin Pines Mall, and this is temporal experiment number one. My calculations are correct.
cues.zh: 我是艾米特·布朗博士。我站在双松购物中心的停车场，这是时间实验一号。我的计算是正确的。

cues.en: When this baby hits 88 miles per hour, you're gonna see some serious shit.
cues.zh: 当这玩意儿达到每小时88英里，你们就会看到一些不得了的东西。

cues.en: It's freezing. Your highness, your blindness, I'm soaring in the sky. Once I remind you, these rappers were Draina. We knew we were Ono when these rappers far behind us. They gotta go on our

cues.en: end is inevitable, Maverick. You kinda set it for extinction.
cues.zh: 是不可避免的，Maverick。你算是把它设定为灭绝了。

cues.en: Fade in. A mental ward. White walls, white sheets, nurses in crisp white uniforms. Broken men shuffle like zombies.
cues.zh: 淡入。一间精神病院。白墙、白床单，穿着笔挺白色制服的护士。崩溃的人们像僵尸一样拖着脚步。

cues.en: We see a hospital wristband on a man's arm, John Doe, and we slowly tilt up to see a man's face,
cues.zh: 我们看到一个男人手臂上的医院腕带，John Doe，镜头缓缓上移，看到一个男人的脸，

cues.en: And he's looking out the window, the afternoon sun on his face, and there's a spark of recognition in his eyes because you know what he's looking at. No. The Okefenokee
cues.zh: 他正望着窗外，午后的阳光照在他脸上，他眼中闪过一丝认出的神情，因为你知道他在看什么。不。奥克弗诺基

cues.en: Swamp. There's a mental hospital there? Right on the water.
cues.zh: 沼泽。那里有精神病院？就在水边。
